scientific.integrity: The theorem is proved uniformly from the first nonzero commutator coefficient. Exhaustive finite computation is a sanity check only and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific.limitations: Prime-field finite truncations only. The statement does not determine centers over arbitrary coefficient fields or of the full Nottingham pro-p group. Two plausible older specialized sources were accessible only through metadata/abstract-level material, leaving a residual risk of an unlocated equivalent formulation.

title: Center of every finite Nottingham truncation
